title: Input Router Output
description: Structured brief produced by the input-router skill before PRD drafting.

Delivery_Mode.description: How the user wants the PRD workflow to run.

Output_Artifacts.description: Expected final outputs for the selected delivery mode.

Active_Sections.description: PRD sections the user has confirmed they want included. Sections not listed here are skipped during drafting. Document Info and Summary are always included and are not listed.

Clarification_Confirmed.description: Set to true only after the user has reviewed, corrected, and explicitly approved the structured JSON in the Step 1.5 clarification gate. Never set to true by the model without user confirmation.

Feature_Name.description: Short human-readable feature name inferred from the input.

JTBD_Candidates.description: JTBD signals extracted from the input. Product Framing will refine and validate these before drafting.

Scope.description: What the feature covers and what it explicitly does not. Out_Of_Scope holds only items the user stated or confirmed.

Glossary.description: Business terms, status names, and role names a reader could misread, each with a one-line meaning from the input context. Transitions and permissions belong in Business_Logic_and_Rules.

AC_Seeds.description: What the user sees or what this story triggers, as stated in the input (UI behavior, how an error is shown, side-effects of the story's own action). Never rule values. Empty array if none.

User_Flow.description: Ordered business steps only. Values, limits, and conditions belong in Business_Logic_and_Rules.

Business_Logic_and_Rules.description: One business rule per item, with concrete values and the condition that triggers it: formulas and rounding, eligibility and conditional policies (including what happens to money, seats, or status when something fails), status transitions, who may act, limits, and how records that exist before launch and actions in progress at launch are treated. Not what the user sees; that belongs in AC_Seeds.

Non_Functional_Requirements.description: Cross-cutting quality expectations as users or the business experience them (perceived speed, availability, platforms, information freshness, expected volume). Who may see what is a business rule; recording a specific action is an AC seed. No infrastructure.

Type.description: Primary: the outcome the feature is for. Secondary: a supporting outcome. Guardrail: what must not get worse while the primary metric improves; its target is a limit.

How_Measured.description: Business definition: what is counted, for whom, over which period.

Owner.description: The role who reports the number and judges the result.

UI_UX_Requirements.description: Screens named in the input (with any design link the input gives) and message wording stated in the input, copied as stated. Behavior on a screen belongs in the story's AC_Seeds.

Dependencies_and_Impacted_Areas.description: Business view only: teams, partners, or existing features this feature relies on or changes. Translate technical notes into business meaning; never list endpoints, payloads, or internal components.

Known_Constraints.description: Constraints on how or when the feature is delivered that the user explicitly stated (including technical ones), copied as stated. Never inferred or expanded. Limits on what users or data may do belong in Business_Logic_and_Rules. Empty array if none.

non_empty_or_needs_clarification.description: Use [NEEDS_CLARIFICATION] when the source input does not provide this information.
